brief:
Displaced Palestinians gathered in Khan Younis to watch a friendly football match, according to Al Jazeera English. The game took place amid the devastation of Gaza's infrastructure, offering residents a rare moment of leisure during the ongoing humanitarian crisis.

The friendly match provided a temporary respite for Palestinians who have been displaced by conflict. Football matches have historically served as a cultural touchstone in Gaza, where the sport carries deep community significance.
dek: Displaced Palestinians gathered to watch a friendly football match in Gaza’s Khan Younis.
title: Palestinians play football amid Gaza's ruins
